requirements.title: REAL storage-size named constants select matching kinds or required negative codes
requirements.definition: REAL16, REAL32, REAL64, and REAL128 are default integer scalar constants for real kinds with storage sizes 16, 32, 64, and 128 bits respectively, or the required negative code -2 or -1 based on larger-kind availability.

pending.REAL-storage-constants-default-integer-s: Assign REAL16, REAL32, REAL64, and REAL128 to default integer variables initialized to -777; assert each KIND equals KIND(0) and each RANK equals 0. Mutate REAL64 to LOGICAL64.
pending.REAL-storage-positive-kind-size: Use requested bit table 16,32,64,128. Generated branch-partition fixtures declare REAL(KIND=constant) values 0.0_constant for positive constants and assert STORAGE_SIZE(value) equals the requested bit count. Mutate the bit table by swapping 64 and 128.
pending.REAL-storage-negative-code-branches: Generated branch-partition fixtures compare REAL_KINDS storage sizes against requested bit table 16,32,64,128 and assert -2 exactly for absence with larger supported size and -1 exactly for absence without larger supported size. Mutate the -2 and -1 expected codes.

requirements.oracle: Source registration only. Future fixtures use exact integer, logical, kind, shape, standard I/O status, and preconnected-unit observations. Processor-dependent unit numbers, kind ordering, storage-unit sizes, image failure capability, lock state from other images, team identity, IOMSG text, and processor-dependent STAT or IOSTAT numeric values are not hard-coded. Positive plans initialize observed variables to distinguished sentinels, exercise the named ISO_FORTRAN_ENV entity with concrete values, and name a feature mutation such as replacing the named constant, changing the requested bit-size table, or substituting a different preconnected unit.
